author: Arnav
problem: Count pairs of positions i < j with j - i at most d where the earlier value is larger than the later one.
bug_description: Inner loop stops at i + d instead of i + d + 1, so pairs exactly d apart are never checked.

comments.accurate: Counts pairs at most d positions apart where the earlier value is larger
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts out-of-order pairs that are fewer than d positions apart
comments.wrong_location: Window bounds verified; check the comparison handles equal values
